flaws.description: Replaced the chart title with a factually incorrect title about male youth employment rate instead of female youth NEET percentage.
Swapped the two hex colour literals in the Education_Index palette to invert MENA and SSA line colours.
Changed the last NEET_Percentage value for SSA in 2022 from 35.6 to 61.6 (35.6 * 1.6 = 56.96, rounded to 61.6 to match precision).
